gigTitle.text: I will be your framer expert for speed optimization and headless cms

briefDescription.text: Hello! I am a Framer Expert with 6+ years of experience converting complex Figma designs into high-performance, pixel-perfect websites. I specialize in custom layoutsno templates, just premium, bespoke digital experiences.  Why Choose Me?  Proven Experience: Successfully delivered 550+ websites and landing pages. Speed Optimization: I build lean, lightning-fast sites to boost conversion and SEO. Headless CMS: Expert setup for dynamic, scalable content management. Pixel-Perfect Conversion: High-fidelity Figma to Framer development. 100% Responsive: Flawless performance on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Advanced Integrations: Seamlessly connect Zapier, HubSpot, Airtable, and Memberstack. High-End Animations: Custom, fluid interactions using Framer Motion and GSAP. SEO Optimized: Built with semantic structure to help you rank higher. My Guarantee  I follow a strict style guide to ensure your project is consistent, maintainable, and scalable. You can expect high-quality code, professional communication, and full confidentiality.  Lets build something extraordinary! Please contact me before placing an order so we can review your design files together.

fields.text: Can you convert my Figma or Adobe XD design into Webflow?
Yes, I specialize in pixel-perfect conversions. I will take your design files and build a fully responsive, high-performance Webflow site that matches your vision exactly across all devices.
Do you provide custom animations, or do you only use templates?

I do not use generic templates. I specialize in high-end, custom interactions using GSAP (Greensock), ScrollTrigger, and SmoothScroller. My goal is to create a 'wow-factor' experience that increases user engagement, as I did for Coral Lab and Total Health Dental Care
Can you integrate third-party tools like HubSpot, Zapier, or payment gateways?

Yes. I can connect your Webflow site to various external services for automation. Whether it’s setting up Zapier workflows, integrating HubSpot for marketing, or adding secure payment processing via Stripe, I handle the full integration

Definitely. I build websites with a clean semantic structure (HTML5/CSS3) and optimize page speed, which are critical for search engine rankings. I also ensure all metadata and alt tags are correctly configured before delivery
What if I need custom code functionality that Webflow doesn't offer natively?

This is where my background as a Senior Frontend Engineer helps. If Webflow’s native tools aren't enough, I can write custom JavaScript to add advanced features, unique UI components, or complex logic that standard 'no-code' developers cannot provide
